Name: Mizu's Dodo
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
Bok bok? This mod is for you if you like all things about dodos! It adds dodos as a new [b]coop [/b]animal.

[list]
[*]Dodos lay [b]Dodo Eggs[/b] every five days.[/*]
[*]At high friendship, Dodos dig up a variety of[b] artifact bones[/b] and [b]island fossils[/b]! They're great for finishing off museums or digs, or turning into fertilizer![/*]
[*]Two cooking recipes to find from the [b]Island Trader.[/b][/*]
[*]Dodo are a tropical treasure! You can trade for a first egg with the [b]Island Trader[/b]. Be careful not to eat it![/*]
[/list][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore [/url]is required to play this mod. [/b]It allows the eggs to spawn around Ginger Island.[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] required to play this mod.[/b] It allows the animal to squeeze through the small door of the coops and drop a variety of items.

This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] compatibility, with 2 new recipes to find and cook up. These recipes use all vanilla items (+ dodo meat) or, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] installed, some of them will change to use those items instead or become flexible if you have it turned on in Cornucopia.

This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] compatibility. If Livestock Bazaar is installed, you can  find a Dodo in northern parts of Ginger Island and lead it home. This option replaces the Dodo Egg being purchasable from the Island Trader.

This mod has optional effects with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] installed to change the text of the recipe book when learning. It's entirely aesthetic.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img]
[/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url]
4. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] for some bonus features
5. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
6. (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
7. You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Any animals and items still left in your save file will [b]safely[/b] be left behind as error items, which can be thrown away or sold by right clicking on animals.

Deleted it by accident? No problem! Just reinstall the mod, and your error items will become normal items again. It's that easy!
